message.content:
The title of “most‑visited market” in New York City depends on how you define a market, but the two stand out:

| Market | Type | Approx. annual visitors | Notes |
|--------|------|------------------------|-------|
| **Union Square Greenmarket** | Farmers’ market | ~1.5 million | The largest and most‑visited farmers’ market in NYC. It runs year‑round on Saturdays, Wednesdays, and Sundays. |
| **Chelsea Market** | Food hall / mixed‑use marketplace | ~2 million | A popular indoor food hall and retail space in the Meatpacking District. It attracts a mix of locals and tourists and is often cited as the city’s most‑visited food market. |

If you’re looking specifically at farmers’ markets, Union Square Greenmarket holds the record. If you’re counting all types of marketplaces—including food halls—Chelsea Market usually tops the list.
